title: Products of integral morphisms are integral
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $J$ be a small set, and let $g_j:T_j\to S$ be integral morphisms [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] for $j\in J$. For the product $T=\prod_{j\in J}T_j$ supplied by [lem-trf-affine-infinite-product-existence], the projection $T\to S$ is integral.

mathlib_searches.query: An arbitrary product of integral morphisms of schemes is integral
mathlib_searches.results: IsIntegralHom.instIsStableUnderBaseChangeScheme and affine/integral instances occur; no arbitrary product theorem.

mathlib_searches.query: Infinite products preserve integral scheme morphisms
mathlib_searches.results: Algebra.IsIntegral.prod is only binary algebra products; no scheme product result.
No declaration matching arbitrary scheme products.
